summary.text: Adam Lee is a Democratic state representative from Auburn, Maine, who has represented House District 89 since December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. An attorney, Lee chairs the House Ethics Committee.

paragraphs.text: He earned a B.A. in history from the University of Texas at Austin in 2002 and a J.D. from Vermont Law and Graduate School in 2007.

His career experience includes working as an attorney with Trafton, Matzen, Belleau & Frenette, as an associate corporation counsel with the City of Portland, Maine, and as a judicial law clerk with the Maine Superior Court.
Lee has been affiliated with the Auburn Pal Center, Big Brothers & Big Sisters, and the Lewiston Auburn Chamber of Commerce.
Lee assumed office in the Maine House on December 6, 2022, succeeding Holly Stover.
He served on the Judiciary Committee in 2023 and 2024 and, for 2025 and 2026, was assigned to the Ethics Committee as chair.
He advanced from the Democratic primary on June 9, 2026.
